'''Burellion Tiy''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] who worked selling [[Starship/Legends|starships]] for the [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub Corporation]] and was also a member of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]].

==Biography==
Tiy was employed by the SoroSuub Corporation and he roamed [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], buying and selling used starships for them. Tiy joined the Rebel Alliance, because he believed that the people of [[Sullust/Legends|Sullust]] should work against the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and he used his job to gather military intelligence for the Alliance. Tiy once sold a squadron of patrol ships to the Empire, which were booby-trapped to pick up phantom electromagentic signals that resembled those of [[X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wings]], causing the Empire to divert forces to investigate a barren system.

==Personality and traits==
Tiy was jocular, fun-loving and liked practical jokes. He often embarrassed customers for a laugh, but SoroSuub didn't fire him for doing so, as he was a shrewd businessman. Tiy only supplied the Alliance with information, as he believed that transporting passengers or contraband for them was too dangerous. Tiy liked to wear garish clothes and owned a large collection of sunglasses. He flew the SoroSuub light [[Transport/Legends|transport]] ''[[Burellion's Deal]]'' and carried a [[QuickSnap 36T]] [[Blaster carbine/Legends|blaster carbine]].
